replication.target_description: This effect investigates the interaction between movement type (grasp vs. ward) and response time to objects. Movement type and response time do not distinguish movement onset from contact time or a main effect of direction from stimulus-by-direction interaction. Both outcome-specific interactions are printed; no unique target follows.

n.sample_role: Candidate abstract count: 27 participants; target-test analytic inclusion unresolved.
n.exclusions: Excerpt reports 14.2 % erroneous trials, 3.3 % early movements and 2.5 SD outlier correction (1.83 % onset, 2.53 % contact, 2.57 % collection); one additional session cancelled. No N derived from these percentages or df.
